identity_guard: THIS IS THE CFE-INFORMED STANDARD DATASET, NOT THE MATCHED CFE EXPERIMENTAL PACK
laws: FAILURE LABEL < FAILURE EXPLANATION < GENERALIZED FAILURE BOUNDARY
TEACHING THE LABEL != ENGINEERING THE PRESSURE

episode_patterns: multiple plausible root causes -> discriminating test -> causal localization -> minimal patch -> regression guard
late failure caused by early state/config assumption -> nonchronological repair while preserving valid work
repeated local patches fail -> data/state representation is refined -> downstream code simplifies
same structural bug reappears under changed surface code -> transfer generalized failure boundary
competing causal explanations -> explicit predictions -> identifying experiment -> selective belief revision
new source changes currentness of one premise -> only dependent conclusions are downgraded
persistent residual/sign flip -> missing-axis/representation audit -> revised model
evidence insufficient -> preserve multiple viable hypotheses / UNKNOWN rather than rhetorical closure
multiple viable plans -> defer unnecessary commitment -> later constraint splits options
tool/resource/authority observation invalidates one branch -> dependency-aware replan
cheap internal reasoning reaches confidence ceiling -> external check/readback -> action
past action consumes resource/creates commitment -> later plan must respect consequential history
later non-negating observation invalidates earlier memory through latent-state change
one attribute changes -> indirect downstream applicability changes while unrelated memories survive
semantic retrieval favors stale item -> currentness/provenance must override similarity
ambiguous current state -> request discriminating update rather than guessing
model prediction -> observed residual -> minimal competing explanations -> best discriminating measurement
new measurement removes some diagnoses while preserving others
measurement outcomes remain ambiguous -> maintain candidate partition
all local candidate models fail -> representation/model class refinement
derivation -> local contradiction -> preserve valid premises -> recompute dependency cone
multiple solution routes -> proof/checker or brute-force discriminator
early symbolic transition error causes downstream divergence -> transition-local verification
simple case requires short reasoning while boundary case earns deeper verification
initial query returns ambiguous entity -> refine query from observation -> grounded finish
several evidence interpretations imply different actions -> obtain one separating observation
tool output conflicts with cached belief -> external observation wins subject to provenance/currentness
tool failure becomes reusable operating constraint rather than repeated blind retry
early state becomes causally binding many turns later
later evidence makes old conclusion stale without explicit negation
failed branch corrected while valid cross-turn state survives
representation itself must refine after later boundary event
unresolved seam persists until a later discriminator arrives

selection_rules: Prefer episodes with at least one observable state-changing discriminator over long performative reasoning.
Prefer local revision with preserved unaffected state over full-reset correction examples.
Prefer external checks whose result can falsify a candidate over self-congratulatory verification language.
Prefer examples where uncertainty is structurally real and the learner must preserve or reduce it.
Prefer cross-domain isomorph coverage rather than repeating one donor vocabulary/domain.
Do not admit an episode merely because its source trace is historically important; learner-visible training value must be independently justified.
ordering_rules: Use broad support before narrow repeated drilling.
Revisit the same stripped invariant under different surface domains after spacing/dependency change.
Include anti-isomorphs where superficially similar cases require different revision/commitment behavior.
Sequence some episodes as coarse-success -> boundary failure -> representation refinement -> later transfer.
Sequence some episodes as failure -> extracted boundary -> surface-varied recurrence to test transfer.
Do not make every episode maximally difficult; train appropriate recruitment of effort by mixing cheap-sufficient and deep-required cases.

reasoning_render_policy.rule: Preserve the minimum reasoning/support state needed to expose discriminators, revision, verification and consequence; do not supervise redundant teacher monologue merely because it exists.
avoid: fake multi-hypothesis created only by paraphrasing the same answer

coverage_measurement.rule: No fixed donor/domain quota is justified by label alone. Measure coverage of stripped invariants and consequence structures.
minimum_reporting: atoms/target tokens by hidden curator dimension

claim_ceiling: This policy applies historically recurrent reasoning-maintenance structures to conventional dataset engineering. It does not establish CFE causality, does not authorize experimental-pack claims, and does not make historical donor ontologies learner-facing.
